description: The reader asks about something they have not written about. The stored records share a mood and some vocabulary but none is the reader's earlier statement on the thing asked about, so the honest answer is that nothing matches. A general lesson from an unrelated record is not a recall.

input.cue: Have I said anything before about how I feel starting a new job?

tool_evidence.excerpt: Moving into the new flat felt unsettling for the first fortnight and then suddenly it did not.
I was nervous before the first rehearsal and it turned out everyone else was too.
I have been reading more slowly this year and I think I am enjoying it more than when I raced through books.
